```yaml
name: Docusaurus CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'website/**'

jobs:
  check_claude:
    name: Check CLAUDE.md size
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Verify CLAUDE.md size
        run: |
          size=$(wc -c < CLAUDE.md)
          echo "CLAUDE.md size: $size bytes"
          if [ "$size" -gt 25000 ]; then
            echo "Error: CLAUDE.md exceeds 25,000 characters."
            exit 1
          fi

  build_and_deploy:
    name: Build & Deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: check_claude
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: website
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Docusaurus site
        working-directory: website
        run: npm run build

      - name: Configure Pages
        id: pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
        with:
          static_site_generator: docusaurus
          generator_config_file: website/docusaurus.config.js
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          enablement: true

      - name: Upload Pages Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: pages
          path: website/build
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          artifact_name: pages
```
